one_liner: Flat cell-shaded cartoon-character graffiti — thick black brushy outlines, a single bright orange/peach rim-halo outline tracing the silhouette, sawtooth-spiked fur edges, pink lightning-bolt exertion sparks, on a flat dark charcoal wall.

primary: New York character-mural lineage — Cope2 rats, T-Kid, Skeme, Sento
Bronx / Brooklyn graf-cartoon tradition — Mighty Mo, Smith, Cope2 mascot rats
European cartoon-mural school — Os Gemeos, Pjotr, Bart Smeets, Mr. Wany
Graffiti character-piece tradition (1990s-2010s) — solid black outline, single rim-glow, flat cell-shade cartooning
lineage.feel: Cheeky, menacing, kinetic street-mascot. NOT a polished vector. NOT a wildstyle letter piece. A spray-and-bucket cartoon character on a wall.

examples: wild-eyed crow with a spray can
sly fox with a stolen sandwich
pose_traits: low and prowling, or perched and scheming
exaggerated body language — hunched shoulders, locked jaw, beady eyes
an object held in mouth, paw, or hand (food, weapon, prop) for narrative hook
horizontal composition — character runs left-to-right across the canvas
what_to_avoid: no letters, no wordmarks, no graffiti-tag text in the piece
no polished 3D render look, no Pixar smoothness, no realistic fur
no sharp vector geometry — this is hand-painted spray-and-brush cartooning

primary_outline.style: Confident brushy aerosol-marker line, slight thickness variation, organic — NOT a uniform vector stroke
primary_outline.rule: Wraps the entire silhouette and every internal feature (face details, paws, fur clusters, mouth, teeth, held objects, body separations)

rim_halo_outline.position: Sits just outside the black primary outline, traces the entire OUTER silhouette only (NOT internal features)
rim_halo_outline.rule: Single continuous rim-glow ring — NOT a multi-band stack, NOT a gradient halo. Hard-edged, flat, and even in width.
rim_halo_outline.purpose: This is the Graf3 signature. It locks the character to the dark wall, gives it a comic-book pop, and reads as the giveaway 'this is a graf character piece' detail.

internal_detail_lines.rule: All internal anatomy (mouth shape, teeth gaps, eye outlines, paw-pad divisions, fur tufts, ear creases) drawn with thinner versions of the primary brushy line — never colored interior lines

fills.technique: Flat cell-shaded — TWO to THREE flat tonal zones per body-part, NOT smooth gradients, NOT airbrushed blends. Each zone is a single even color separated by a hard edge.
fills.shadow_strategy: A darker tone of the same hue applied as a flat shape on the underside / away-from-light side of each form (under belly, under head, far leg, inside ear, under jaw). Hard-edged, no soft blend.
fills.highlight_strategy: Optional — sometimes a single lighter-tone flat shape on top-facing surfaces (top of head, top of haunch). Used sparingly. Most highlight reading comes from leaving the midtone exposed against the shadow.

palette.rim_halo_color_rule: Default rim-halo is bright orange-peach #F08C42. Swap to cyan #5BD4E8 or yellow #F2C530 only if the body palette shares orange (e.g. rust_dog, toxic_bee) — pick a complementary that POPS off both the body AND the dark wall.

silhouette_treatment.fur_or_feather_edge: Sawtooth-spiked silhouette along the back, head crown, shoulders, haunches, and tail base — fur is implied by the EDGE of the silhouette being jagged and irregular, not by painting individual hairs
silhouette_treatment.spike_geometry: Triangular tufts of varying length, 3-12% of the local body diameter, clustered in 2-5 spike groups along major contours
silhouette_treatment.soft_zones: Belly, paw bottoms, snout, inside-ear, and tail tip read as smooth-curved silhouette (no spikes)
silhouette_treatment.rule: The silhouette tells half the story — make it instantly readable as the creature even if you blacked everything inside.

lightning_bolt_sparks.shape: Three- to four-segment zig-zag lightning-bolt shapes (classic comic-book exertion / impact mark)
lightning_bolt_sparks.color: Salmon-pink #F2B0B8 with a thin black outline
lightning_bolt_sparks.placement: On joints under stress, behind/around the head, near gripped objects — places where a comic artist would draw motion or effort emphasis

eye_treatment.shape: Wedge-shaped or angled-rectangle angry eyes — half-closed predator stare
eye_treatment.pupil: Optional — if present, a small black dot or short hard-edged slit; often omitted entirely for a more menacing all-white look

tooth_treatment.shape: Hard triangular fangs / blocky chompers, not realistic dentition
tooth_treatment.rule: If the mouth is open or gripping something, lock the teeth ONTO the object — they should bite into it visually, not float near it

skin_accents.where: Inner ears, nose tip, paw pads, tail underside, tongue, snout interior
skin_accents.rule: Pink skin accents are a critical chromatic punch against the grey body — every Graf3 creature gets at least 3-5 pink-skin moments

highlights_and_accents.no_starbursts: Graf3 does NOT use star-burst chrome reflections (that's Graf1/Graf2). The lightning-bolt sparks replace them.
highlights_and_accents.no_drips: Graf3 does NOT use letter-style drip accents — the cartoon character does not drip paint. Spray-can splatter is also absent or near-absent.

depth_and_dimensionality.drop_shadow: None — the figure does NOT cast a separate ground shadow. The dark wall background is its only shadow context.
depth_and_dimensionality.extrusion_or_3d_block: None — Graf3 is FLAT 2D cell-shading. No 3D block, no extrusion, no bevel.
depth_cues: internal flat shadow shapes (fur shadow, jaw shadow, far-leg shadow)
occlusion overlap between body parts (near leg crosses far leg, near ear crosses head)
size scaling of held objects (cheese in foreground reads slightly larger / brighter than tail in background)

background.texture: Subtle and OPTIONAL — a faint concrete-wall haze or roller-paint mottling at very low contrast (within +/- 8 of the base value). Mostly reads as flat dark.
no_no: no white background (Graf1 is white, Graf3 is dark wall)
no brick wall, no plywood, no metal panel, no graffiti-on-graffiti background
no sky, no horizon, no ground plane, no floor
no environmental context, no other tags, no street furniture
background.rule: The dark charcoal wall is part of the look. The orange rim-halo outline pops off it. Without the dark wall, the rim-halo loses its purpose.

atmosphere_and_lighting.lighting_model: Implied flat-cartoon directional light from upper-left — defines which body zones get the lighter midtone vs. the flat shadow tone
atmosphere_and_lighting.atmospheric_glow: None — no ambient glow, no halo aura behind the figure, no overspray mist. The rim-halo outline does the popping work.
atmosphere_and_lighting.spray_can_evidence: Minimal. The medium reads as marker-and-bucket-paint cartooning more than aerosol fade. Avoid heavy speckle / overspray — that drags it toward Graf1 territory.

composition.format: Horizontal banner — character runs left to right across the canvas
composition.negative_space_rule: Leave 8-15% breathing room above and below the character. Held props (cheese, bone, etc.) can extend into the left or right margin.
composition.baseline_rule: Character anchors to the lower-middle band of the canvas, not floating dead-center. Slight downward weight reads as 'on the ground'.
composition.view_angle: Side profile or three-quarter view. NEVER front-on / face-the-camera (that flattens the silhouette).

mood.primary: Cheeky, menacing, kinetic — a street-mascot up to no good

do_not: do not render letters or words anywhere in the piece
do not use chrome-metallic fills (that's Graf2)
do not use multi-stop aerosol gradient fills (that's Graf1)
do not use a pure white studio background (that's Graf1)
do not use a star-burst sparkle (use the lightning-bolt mark instead)
do not add a 3D drop-block or bevel (Graf3 is flat 2D)
do not add radial halo aura behind the character (the rim-halo outline replaces it)
do not paint individual fur hairs (use the sawtooth silhouette technique)
do not add overspray drips from the figure
do not photograph it on a brick / concrete / textured wall — flat charcoal only
do not include any signature, watermark, or tag in the prompt — signing is a post-step

prompt_skeleton.open: Ultra-detailed flat cell-shaded cartoon-character graffiti mural in the Graf3 spray-cartoon style, rendered on a flat dark charcoal wall background (#1A1A1E) — no letters, no wordmarks, no tags, no environmental context.
prompt_skeleton.linework: Thick confident charcoal-black (#0F0F12) brushy aerosol-marker outline wrapping the entire silhouette and every internal feature, organic varying line-weight, NOT a uniform vector stroke. A single bright orange-peach (#F08C42) rim-halo outline tracing the OUTER silhouette only, hard-edged and even-width, sitting just outside the black outline.
prompt_skeleton.fills: Flat cell-shaded fills — two to three flat tonal zones per body-part with hard-edged shadow shapes, NO gradients, NO airbrushed blends. {PALETTE_DESCRIPTION}.
prompt_skeleton.silhouette: Sawtooth-spiked fur (or feather) silhouette along the back, head crown, shoulders, haunches, and tail base — fur implied by jagged silhouette edge, NOT painted hairs. Smooth-curve silhouette on belly, snout, paw pads, inner ears.
prompt_skeleton.accents: Three to six salmon-pink (#F2B0B8) lightning-bolt zig-zag exertion sparks scattered around joints and behind the head, each with a thin black outline. Hard-white (#FFFFFF) wedge-shaped angry eyes outlined in black, no pupils. Hard-white triangular fangs locked onto the held object. Salmon-pink skin accents on inner ears, nose tip, paw pads, tail underside.
prompt_skeleton.background_lock: Flat dark charcoal wall background (#1A1A1E), subtle concrete-haze at very low contrast or fully flat. NO brick, NO plywood, NO white background, NO sky, NO horizon, NO floor, NO other tags, NO graffiti context behind the character.
prompt_skeleton.framing: Horizontal 16:9 composition, character running left-to-right across the canvas filling 70-85% of the width, side-profile or three-quarter view, anchored to the lower-middle band of the canvas. Gallery-grade Samsung Frame TV mural-character presentation, ultra-detailed.
